pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies_comment: node-pty ships prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows only, so on Linux it compiles pty.node at install time. pnpm >= 10 skips a dependency's build scripts unless it is listed here, and install still exits 0 — the failure only surfaces later as 'Failed to load native module: pty.node'. node-gyp is a devDependency because pnpm, unlike npm, does not supply one: node-pty's install script calls bare `node-gyp`, which otherwise resolves to whatever the machine happens to have (nothing on many, or a years-old distro build that produces a pty.node that segfaults).
pnpm.comment: Version-scoped overrides bump only the vulnerable major of transitive deps to a patched release, leaving other resolved majors (e.g. path-to-regexp@0.1.x, used by other tooling) untouched. minimatch@10 is replaced by 11 rather than a patched 10: the amplification fix (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) landed in 11.0.1 and 10.x has no patched release, while its only consumer here is readdir-glob under archiver, which asks for ^10.2.2 and uses the Minimatch class that 11 still exports. The patterns are ours — server/zip.ts names paths, it does not take a glob from the client — so this closes an advisory rather than a reachable hole.
